name: squat-jump

alsoFrom.why: A squat jump's dip is a squat with a jump out of it (Kd's research file: a bodyweight squat followed by an explosive vertical jump), so what a squat holds there, the chest and the stance, is set from the squat's people too: four squat-jump people alone, one left out, set the chest from 45 to 62 degrees and the stance from 0.13 to 0.17.

phone: On the floor or a low stand, 2 to 3 metres away, the whole body in the picture with room above the head for the jump: side-on, from the front, or in between.

ready.from: Standing tall: the knees within 20 degrees of straight (the usual definition; not fitted).
Standing tall: the trunk within 20 degrees of upright (the usual definition; not fitted).

rules.name: depth

standard.source: The hips sink at least this far, in legs, when both knees bend to 125 degrees, the knees' line (120 and the camera's room): a hip stands no higher above its ankle than a leg bent so allows, thigh and shin of equal length (Drillis and Contini, as Winter gives them): 1 - sin(62.5 degrees) = 0.113.

rules.unseen: Keep your whole body in view.
rules.from: Set by movement-check from the form standard, 0.113 (its source beside it), the least the body allows, so with no room of its own; rounded the forgiving way. The people's shallowest rep reads 0.35.

rules.name: knees bent

standard.source: Kd's research file, "Squat Jump Guide": lower to a quarter or half squat, the knees at about 90 to 120 degrees at the bottom (a full-depth squat slows the jump). The line is its shallow end, 120, plus the camera's own room (the forgiving way).

rules.unseen: Keep your whole body in view.
rules.from: Set by movement-check from the form standard, 120 (its source beside it), plus the camera's own room on this reading: the same rep's change from as filmed to each replay that sets numbers, in 99 reps of 100 (144 reps, 4 people): 7.59; rounded the forgiving way. Their shallowest rep reads 105.44.

rules.name: chest up
rules.unseen: Keep your whole body in view.
rules.from: Set by movement-check from 4 people's videos (scripts/movementVideos.ts), as filmed and as each replay that sets numbers (scripts/replays.ts), 539 reps: beyond the furthest rep by half its distance from the middle rep (54.06; standing 3.19).

rules.name: feet leave the floor

standard.source: The smallest jump the squat never counts (NEVER_JUMP, 52a-ii-a: under Kd's lowest real squat jump, 12 cm), so no rep is both a squat and a squat jump; between the squat's own "feet stay down" (4 cm) and this, neither counts. The pose model's own foot points wander up to 7 cm on a split squat's step, under it.

rules.from: Set by movement-check from its standard, 0.08 (its source beside it), used as it is. The people's furthest rep reads 0.12.
